capabilities: Sync tagged reMarkable notebooks, PDFs and EPUBs into vault notes
Transcribe handwriting with local or cloud backends
Extract PDF and EPUB highlights as linked quotes with block IDs
Send vault notes and PDFs to the reMarkable tablet
Write annotations to Zotero and Readwise
disambiguation: Not a general tag-sync tool; it syncs reMarkable documents selected by a tag into Obsidian.
extras: Desktop only; free core with optional €24 one-time Pro licence; unofficial and not affiliated with reMarkable or Readwise; direct tablet sync on Paper Pro/Pure requires Developer Mode, which erases the device.
problem: reMarkable notes and annotations are trapped on the tablet and not searchable or linkable inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Tag a notebook or a PDF on your reMarkable, and it lands in the vault folder you mapped
Your reMarkable highlights land in Zotero as native annotations.
Your reMarkable highlights land in your Readwise library as ordinary highlights

summary: Unofficial plugin that syncs tagged reMarkable notebooks, PDFs and EPUBs into Obsidian as Markdown notes with handwriting transcripts and highlight digests.
